rules.when: Task needs live web facts: breaking news, current events, today's market/product state.
rules.why: Only the Grok TUI has live web access.

rules.when: Recon-only, file gathering, narrow lookup, or a trivial mechanical edit (rename, format sweep, typo fix).
rules.why: Cheapest tier. Grok 4.7 here is a quota fallback, not a first pick.

rules.when: Ordinary implementation, bounded bug fix, tests, everyday coding with a clear path.
rules.why: Workhorse tier. Grok 4.7 here is a quota fallback, not a first pick.

rules.when: Large/ambiguous multi-file change, risky refactor, work holding many moving parts at once.
rules.why: Same Sol model as workhorse tier, more thinking budget. Grok 4.7 here is a quota fallback, not a first pick.

rules.when: Hardest available work: root-cause investigation, architecture, ambiguous design, or already failed on the workhorse tier.
rules.why: Frontier tier, reserve for this only. Never Claude fable: it stalls unattended on a usage-credit prompt.
